data.value: Will the program officer at the Alder Foundation respond substantively to nonprofit director Lucia Ferreyra's unsolicited concept note within one month?

The Alder Foundation accepts unsolicited concept notes via email. Lucia Ferreyra can send her concept note to the foundation's general submissions email or directly to the program officer if she knows their contact. The program officer typically responds substantively (e.g., with feedback, a request for more information, or an invitation to submit a full proposal) to a small fraction of unsolicited notes, usually within a month if interested.
